## Quick facts

- **Title:** Founding Engineer

## Summary

Kevin Gámez is a founding engineer in Bogotá, Colombia, looking for the next thing. He was the founding engineer at Enttor from March 2025 to July 2026, a MaC Venture Capital-backed startup based in New York, where he worked remotely and owned engineering on a six-person team. He built three products there: a paid-ads platform on Meta and TikTok, the Slack agent that runs it, and an AI ad studio that generates the creative. Before Enttor he was a product engineer at Samsam, a Neo-backed e-commerce marketplace, and before that a software engineer at Heinsohn Human Global Solutions. He has a Master's in Information Engineering from Universidad de los Andes, which he did part-time while working.

He ships TypeScript and Next.js day to day, reaches for Python on ML work, and has also shipped Swift, JavaScript, Java and Dart. The hero of his site runs Conway's Game of Life, and his undergraduate thesis was deep learning for crop identification on satellite imagery.

## Experience

### Founding Engineer, Enttor (March 2025 - July 2026)

Location: New York, remote. Backed by MaC Venture Capital. Team of six.

- It started as the outbound engine: browser agents sourcing prospects on Instagram and LinkedIn and drafting the DMs.
- It ended as a multi-tenant paid-ads platform: Meta and TikTok campaign data normalized onto one metric schema, and a rules engine that returns scale, pause or archive with a reason.
- Built a Slack agent media buyers drive in plain language across 165 tools on the Meta and TikTok ad APIs.
- Built an AI ad studio that generates ads from a brand URL, then takes them back apart into editable layers on GPU workers. Ad generation went from an hour to under 5 minutes.
- Stack: TypeScript, Next.js, Supabase, Postgres with row level security, Playwright, Claude, Python on Modal.

### Product Engineer, Samsam (February 2024 - March 2025)

Location: Bogotá. Industry: e-commerce marketplace. Backed by Neo.

- Shipped both sides of the marketplace: a React Native and Expo app for shoppers and a Next.js dashboard for merchants, on NestJS services with Prisma and Postgres.
- Made API response times 10% faster and routed production alerts by severity.

### Software Engineer, Heinsohn Human Global Solutions (October 2022 - December 2023)

Location: Bogotá. Industry: HR and payroll software.

- Moved manual deploys to Azure and built the CI/CD that released to every client server on its own.
- Owned a Python and Flask reporting service running scheduled queries across client databases.
- Built the Power BI dashboards clients used to track headcount, turnover and payroll cost.
- Stack: Python, Flask, Java, Spring Boot, Azure, Power BI.

## Education

### Universidad de los Andes - M.Sc. Information Engineering (January 2024 - May 2025)

Four semesters, part-time while working, in the Department of Systems and Computing. A programme about the whole life of data: governance, security and data quality, with coursework in applied data science, big data, machine learning, recommender systems, knowledge engineering, and security and privacy.

### Universidad de los Andes - B.Sc. Systems and Computing (January 2019 - December 2023)

Five years on systems, algorithms and applied ML, with minors in Mathematics and Management (both closed December 2022). Thesis: "Deep Learning en agricultura: conceptos y aplicaciones en la identificación de cultivos sobre imágenes satelitales" (crops from satellite imagery, 98.4% accuracy, 0.991 F1).

### Honors and certifications

- Andrés Bello National Distinction (2018), Ministry of Education, Colombia, for a top-ranked score on the Saber 11 national exam
- AWS Academy Cloud Developing (2022)
- AWS Academy Cloud Foundations (2021)

## Selected work

- **AI Ad Studio** - Enttor's last product. Scrapes a brand's logos, colors and fonts, writes ad concepts with Claude, renders and checks them, then uses OCR and segmentation to turn finished ads into editable layers. Next.js, Python, PyTorch, Modal, Supabase.
- **Slack Agent** - a Slack bot media buyers talk to like a coworker, 165 tools across the Meta and TikTok ad APIs, with a router that narrows each message to a shortlist. Claude tool use, pgvector.
- **Enttor Platform** - prospect sourcing and outreach on Instagram and LinkedIn, refocused in 2026 on paid ads with Meta and TikTok insights on one metric schema. Next.js, Supabase, Postgres RLS.
- **MakeMotionGraphics** - text to looping motion graphics. Claude writes an HTML scene, screenshots it in headless Chrome to check its own output, and records it to MP4. Puppeteer, ffmpeg.
- **LinkedIn Editor** - a chat-first editor for LinkedIn posts, grounded by search over posts that performed. pgvector RAG, Next.js.
- **Browser Automation Infrastructure** - Node services keeping authenticated browser sessions alive on four platforms. Kevin contributed the Instagram pipeline and session handling. Playwright, Redis, Postgres.
